title: MedCaseAgent: From Multimodal Clinical Evidence to Rare Disease Case Reports
abstract: arXiv:2610.32258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated potential in clinical documentation, generating the rigorous, evidence-based reasoning required for unprecedented, atypical, and rare disease case reports remains a significant challenge. We present MedCaseAgent, an end-to-end agentic reasoning paradigm that bridges this gap by synthesizing publication-quality reports from unstructured clinical notes. MedCaseAgent leverages a hierarchical structure, integrating patient-level data mining with iterative, tool-integrated reasoning. By dynamically querying medical literature and knowledge bases, the agent maintains high clinical fidelity and assesses case novelty. The framework is inherently modular, supporting various backbone LLMs in a plug-and-play fashion. translated_title: MedCaseAgent：从多模态临床证据到罕见病病例报告
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）已在临床文档记录方面展现出潜力，但为前所未有的、非典型性的罕见疾病病例报告生成所需的严格的、基于证据的推理仍然是一项重大挑战。我们提出了MedCaseAgent，这是一种端到端的智能体推理范式，通过从非结构化临床笔记中综合生成发表级质量的报告来弥合这一差距。MedCaseAgent采用分层结构，将患者层面的数据挖掘与迭代式的、工具集成的推理相结合。通过动态查询医学文献和知识库，该智能体保持了高度的临床保真度并评估病例的新颖性。该框架具有天然的模块化特性，支持以即插即用的方式使用各种骨干LLM。为促进这一研究，我们发布了MedCase-150K——一个大规模多模态临床病例报告语料库，以及MedCase-Bench——一个基于时间留出的稳健评估套件。
tldr: 提出MedCaseAgent端到端智能体推理框架，能从非结构化临床笔记自动生成发表级质量的罕见病病例报告，并同步发布大规模多模态语料库MedCase-150K和时间留出评估基准MedCase-Bench。
